title: Trump says 'largely true' Iran war led to Republican midterm loss
summary: After Democrats won both the House and Senate in a blowout for Republicans, President Donald Trump admitted fuel prices brought on by the Iran war impacted the outcome, but stuck by his decision. DW…
byline: Elizabeth Schumacher, Richard Connor, Karl Sexton, Jenipher Camino Gonzalez, Wesley Dockery, Natalie Muller

image.caption: Trump insisted his unpopular war on Iran was 'the only answer'Image: Evan Vucci/REUTERS

blocks.text: IN DEPTH: Democrats take House and Senate from Republicans in US midterm rout

blocks.caption: Texas is sending a Democrat to the US Senate for the first time since 1988Image: Mike Segar/REUTERS

blocks.text: By late Tuesday night, it was clear that Democrats had succeeded in turning the 2026 US midterm elections into the so-called "blue wave" that had been predicted by pollsters.
But by Wednesday morning, the scale of the victory had turned into a "blue tsunami," surprising even the most optimistic political pundits.
For more on Tuesday nights results, which saw the Democrats flip seats in several Republican strongholds, head over to our report.
